stem:
An artist started with some paint bottles. The artist buys the same number of additional bottles each week. The table shows the linear relationship between x, the number of weeks, and y, the number of bottles that the artist has.

Paint Bottles

| Number of Weeks, x | Number of Bottles, y |
|--------------------|----------------------|
| 4                  | 25                   |
| 7                  | 34                   |
| 12                 | 49                   |
| 15                 | 58                   |

How many bottles did the artist have at the start?
